extracted.name: Chocolate Crinkles
instruction_lines: Melt the butter and the chocolate on a double boiler
Mix cocoa powder, sugar, melted butter and melted chocolate
Add vanilla extract. Then add eggs one at a time
On a separate bowl, mix the all purpose flour, salt, and baking soda
Add the dry ingredients slowly to the wet mixture.
Store the balls in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours.
Make into 1 inch balls and place them in a cookie sheet.
Bring the balls out of the refrigerator and cover in confectioners sugar.
Let cool for 5 mins and transfer to cooling rack
